routeCharacter: Starts at Åsa/Vita Sand and follows Åsa kustpromenad with sea views.
Uses cycle path/local road or shared-use infrastructure around Krokvik/Vassbäck/Rågelund.
Returns to coast and old railway embankment before Vallersvik.
Passes Vallersvik and Torstensvik bathing areas.
Continues through villa/residential areas and over coastal meadows north of Löftaån.
Final approach passes under the railway and through woodland/residential areas to Frillesås centre.

hazards.description: Åsa kustpromenad and Torstensvik/coastal parts include rocks, boardwalks and stairs. Easy grade still includes localized uneven/slippery coastal footing.
Low coastal route can be exposed to wind, wet rock, waves/high-water effects and summer crowding around beaches.
Official route passes shore meadows north of Löftaån, known for birdlife. Stay on marked path and keep dogs controlled; no source-confirmed flood closure found.
Official page says the route passes under the railway before Frillesås. This is an underpass context, not a level-crossing claim.
The route uses cycle path/local streets and residential areas around Krokvik/Rågelund/Vallersvik/Frillesås. Treat as route character and standard traffic awareness rather than a special hazard.
